findings.title: Tactics: the teal header strip is code-drawn; the teal panels are a literal the Studio can already swap
findings.text: Asked under Ocean, one inspector call at a time. (1) The header strip is an SIGradient set by the game's code (start #20665A, end #036150, its border #32755D, no rule, style rules ignored): nothing a skin can reach. (2) The Substitutes block and its teal frame take background #036150 from the stylesheet LITERAL in AlwaysAppliedStyleSheet .tactics-subs-block (not a token, not code): Look at it already offers a literal swap of #036150 (10 game rules copied, 8 selectors, under the 50 limit), but the three-colour theme does not write it. (3) The pitch interior is --colours-tactics-base-50 (#142331 under Ocean): it IS themed. Earlier text that called all of it 'drawn in code' was wrong for (2) and (3).
findings.fix: (1) accept as a recorded limit of 1.2.0. (2) a candidate for LATER work: have the theme write a #036150 literal swap (no generator change before the release candidate). (3) works.

findings.title: Radars, scatter plot and the Finances chart are drawn by code
findings.text: The Data Hub radars (FMSpiderChart), the Aerial scatter plot (FMScatterChart) and the Finances chart (FMLineChart) expose no stylesheet colour to the inspector. The radar fill is identical in all three themes. The Finances chart LINE follows the theme's accent family (pale green, pale blue, near-white); its purple FILL does not.
findings.fix: No token or rule found that changes the fills. Not changeable from the Studio's colours.

findings.title: The green 'Performing ...' pills are a fixed family colour
findings.text: The pill text is #B8EAB3 from --theme-color-green-soft-soft, which the map neither sets nor keeps by design (it is in no map entry).
findings.fix: Change it as a single token in Colours (every colour a rule uses is listed there).

findings.title: Chips, badges, status words and data scales keep the game's colours
findings.text: Position and role chips, Inj / Wnt / BPR / FtT / Bid badges, rating pills, the green recruitment-team names, facility pills, the red and green arrows. They are hue-family colours the map keeps (148 kept tokens): three input colours cannot derive them.
findings.fix: By design in this version; each can be changed in Colours.

findings.title: Training calendar grid is not tinted; its tiles use family colours
findings.text: The grid, the day containers and the events body have NO background of their own (transparent, no rule), so the calendar sits on the page layer behind the cards. The activity tiles are code-set gradients that name --colours-calendar-training-*-start/end (family tokens the map keeps). The Rest and Travel tile fill was not located.
findings.fix: Family tokens could be added to the map later; the grid itself has nothing to change.

findings.title: Competition headers, zone bars and the breaking-news banner keep the game's colours
findings.text: Bundesliga dark green, Champions League blue, DFB-Pokal green, Supercup grey; UCL/UEL zone bars; the own club's orange-red row; the orange BREAKING NEWS banner.
findings.fix: By design; each is a game colour.

findings.title: Club colours stay as you chose
findings.text: The yellow top bars, the yellow wallpaper streaks, the yellow shirts and the olive board panel are Borussia Dortmund's own colours (the skins were made with 'keep each club's colours').

findings.title: The theme's text colour reaches the game
findings.text: Inspector: the radar container, the Finances chart and a Data Hub element resolve 'color' to #E6EFE9, Forest's own primary text colour.

findings.title: Defender badge: entry and pair removed (owner decision)
findings.text: The chip label 'D (C)' is painted by .text-regular (#FFFFFF), not by --data-player-position-defender-foreground, which no style rule uses. The role-map entry and the badge pair were removed (82 entries, 42 checked pairs). The chip's FILL source was not found; one chip, one screen, one theme. Found later (Ocean, 2026-11-16): the chip FILL is the token --colours-tactics-defender-background (#00756B), which the map keeps at the game's colour; changeable as one token in Colours.

findings.title: Portal: 'No Recommendations' overlaps the line below it
findings.text: In the small Player Recommendations card the heading overlaps its sentence in all three themes; the larger Recruitment panel does not. Probably that card's own layout; not compared with the default skin.

findings.title: Team Instructions: crowded labels on the pitch map
findings.text: 'N. Schlotterbeck' overlaps the DM and WCB chips near the centre circle. Not compared with the default skin.

findings.title: No contrast was measured in the game
findings.text: Every readability call is by eye. The 7 pairs the offline check cannot compute and the 148 kept colours were not examined one by one. The dimmest text seen: 'Style' and 'Mentality' in the Tactics selectors.

findings.title: The continue button follows the theme's accent
findings.text: 'Review Team Selection' is green under Forest, blue under Ocean and #F2B33D under Slate and amber (inspector). Its tokens --continue-button-default-grad-l/r are not in the map and the index says purple #A40FC7: another definition wins in the game; not traced.

findings.title: The 148 kept colours: inventoried, only partly seen in the game
findings.text: Inventory in docs/evidence/s2-kept-tokens-20261116.json. Seen in the game: the defender chip fill, one calendar tile family, the continue button. Not seen: colours-base (71), colours-linear (29), colours-data (10), communication-feedback (4), data-average (4) and the rest of tactics and calendar. The 7 unchecked pairs were computed from the game's chip fills (all 5.59 or more), not measured in the game.
